title: SettingsView merge conflict with inkling-stream / lfm-moe-stream at the same insertion line
scenario: Merging inkling-lamq together with inkling-stream or lfm-moe-stream. Each one inserts a line right after `MemorySection(ignoreMemoryCheck: $ignoreMemoryCheck)`. `git merge-tree origin/inkling-lamq origin/inkling-stream` reports CONFLICT (content) here. If someone resolves it by picking one side, either the lamq section or the streaming section silently disappears from Settings.
evidence: merge-tree output: '<<<<<<< origin/inkling-lamq / if ModelCatalog.deviceMemoryGB >= 14 { LamqSettingsSection() } / ======= / StreamingSection() / >>>>>>> origin/inkling-stream'. lfm-moe-stream gives the same conflict.
fix: When resolving, keep both lines: `StreamingSection()` followed by `if ModelCatalog.deviceMemoryGB >= 14 { LamqSettingsSection() }`.
notes: UPHELD(high): I confirmed the claim; it is not refuted. I ran `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/inkling-lamq origin/inkling-stream` and the same command with lfm-moe-stream after a fresh fetch. Both report "CONFLICT (content)" in ios/AgentConsole/Views/SettingsView.swift. In both merged trees the conflict hunk is at line 54. The inkling-lamq side adds `if ModelCatalog.deviceMemoryGB >= 14 { LamqSettingsSection() }` and the other side adds `StreamingSection()`, each placed right after `MemorySection(ignoreMemoryCheck: $ignoreMemoryCheck)`, the last line before the Form body closes. Git cannot auto-resolve this, so a merge by hand that takes only one side would drop the other section without any error. The fix is correct: keep both lines, since neither depends on the other. Low severity is right, because it is a textual conflict that git flags, not something that merges silently. The same merges also conflict in MLXBackend.swift and build.yml, and lfm-moe-stream conflicts in ModelCatalog.swift too, but those files are outside this claim.

UPHELD(high): I could not refute the claim; it holds. I ran `git merge-tree` (with and without --write-tree) on origin/inkling-lamq against origin/inkling-stream and against origin/lfm-moe-stream. Both report "CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in ios/AgentConsole/Views/SettingsView.swift". The conflict is the hunk right after `MemorySection(ignoreMemoryCheck: $ignoreMemoryCheck)`: lamq adds `if ModelCatalog.deviceMemoryGB >= 14 { LamqSettingsSection() }` and the other side adds `StreamingSection()`. That matches line 54 of the lamq SettingsView.swift. Both added lines are independent views, and the private `StreamingSection` struct merges cleanly. So the fix of keeping both lines is correct. One caveat: git flags this as an explicit conflict, so nothing is lost silently unless a person resolves it by picking one side. Low severity fits. Both merges also conflict in MLXBackend.swift, build.yml and ENGINEERING-LOG.md, and lfm-moe-stream also conflicts in ModelCatalog.swift.

title: ModelCatalog merge conflict with lfm-moe-stream (adjacent block insertions)
scenario: inkling-lamq adds the LamqBuild block (lines ~105-153) and lfm-moe-stream adds StreamedBuild and the stream tiers at the same spot after the Inkling entries. merge-tree reports CONFLICT (content) at merged lines 115-271. The two blocks define no colliding symbols (LamqBuild/lamq39/47/54/lamqBuilds vs StreamedBuild/inklingTiers/lfmStreamTiers), but a one-sided resolution drops `lamqBuilds`, and LamqSettingsSection.swift:13 would then fail to compile.
evidence: git merge-tree --write-tree origin/inkling-lamq origin/lfm-moe-stream gives conflict markers in ModelCatalog.swift at 115/166/271. Grepping the other branches finds no lamq/LamqBuild/Plan identifiers.
fix: Resolve by keeping both blocks in full. Check that `ModelCatalog.lamqBuilds` still exists after the merge.
notes:
UPHELD(high): The claim holds, but the suggested fix needs a correction. I ran `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/inkling-lamq origin/lfm-moe-stream` and it reports CONFLICT (content) in ios/AgentConsole/Inference/ModelCatalog.swift. The merged file has the markers at lines 115, 166 and 271. The inkling-lamq side (115-165) holds `struct LamqBuild`, lamq39/47/54 and `static let lamqBuilds`. The lfm-moe-stream side (167-270) holds `struct StreamedBuild`, `static let inklingTiers` (line 232) and `lfmStreamTiers`. ios/AgentConsole/Views/LamqSettingsSection.swift on inkling-lamq uses `ForEach(ModelCatalog.lamqBuilds)`, so taking only the lfm-moe-stream side breaks the compile there.

The correction: "keep both blocks in full" is not compile-safe either. Each side declares its own `static let all: [Entry]`, at line 165 (`[...] + inklingTiers`) and at 269-270 (`[...] + lfmStreamTiers + inklingTiers`). Concatenating the two sides gives a duplicate `all` declaration, which is a redeclaration error. The right fix keeps the LamqBuild block and the StreamedBuild/inklingTiers/lfmStreamTiers block, plus exactly one `all`: the lfm-moe-stream form `[lfm3_1_7b, lfm25_1_2b, lfm25_350m, lfm25_8b_a1b, qwen3_1_7b] + lfmStreamTiers + inklingTiers`. Then confirm that `inklingTiers` is declared only once and that `ModelCatalog.lamqBuilds` still exists.

The same merge also conflicts in MLXBackend.swift, SettingsView.swift, build.yml and ENGINEERING-LOG.md. Severity low-medium (a merge hazard, not a defect in either branch alone).

UPHELD(high): I could not refute the claim. I checked it as follows. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/inkling-lamq origin/lfm-moe-stream` (tree 774b95ee) reports `CONFLICT (content)` in ios/AgentConsole/Inference/ModelCatalog.swift. It also reports conflicts in MLXBackend.swift, SettingsView.swift, build.yml and ENGINEERING-LOG.md.

The conflict hunk in ModelCatalog sits right after `inkling2MiniGPTQ3`. The inkling-lamq side adds LamqBuild, overheadGB, lamq39/47/54, `lamqBuilds` and its own `static let all = [...] + inklingTiers`. The lfm-moe-stream side adds StreamedBuild, dwqStream*, inkling2MiniStream25/19/50/100, inklingTiers, lfm8b* and lfmStreamTiers, plus a different `static let all`. Apart from `all`, the two sides share no symbol names.

The dependency is real: `ModelCatalog.lamqBuilds` is defined at inkling-lamq ModelCatalog.swift:152 and used at LamqSettingsSection.swift:13. If the conflict is resolved by taking only the lfm-moe-stream side, that use no longer compiles.

The two `static let all` lines also conflict with each other. The fix is to keep both blocks in full but write a single `all` that includes both inklingTiers and lfmStreamTiers, exactly as lfm-moe-stream intends. A duplicate `all` would itself be a redeclaration compile error.

Low severity is right: the conflict will definitely occur and is easy to resolve by hand.

title: build.yml conflict with inkling-kernels; VENDORED.md auto-merges with two items numbered '4.' and a stale patch list
scenario: (1) Merging with inkling-kernels: both branches add a Metal-kernel compile step and a Python test step at the same places in .github/workflows/build.yml. merge-tree reports conflicts at two hunks, and a one-sided resolution drops one kernel compile check. (2) Merging with inkling-stream or lfm-moe-stream: VENDORED.md merges without a conflict, but the result has two items numbered '4.' (patch C and patch D), and the summary line reads 'marked [agent-console patch A/B/C]', which leaves out D. The file stops matching what was actually patched.
evidence: merge-tree origin/inkling-lamq vs origin/inkling-kernels: build.yml conflict markers at lines 86-96 and 105-109. The merged VENDORED.md (lamq + inkling-stream) shows '4. SSD expert streaming ... [agent-console patch C]' followed later by '4. `[agent-console patch D]`'.
fix: In build.yml keep both steps (check_metal_kernels.py and check_lamq_metal_kernels.py, plus both test steps). In VENDORED.md renumber the lamq item to 5 and change the summary to 'A/B/C/D' when merging after the streaming branch.
notes:
UPHELD(high): I reproduced both parts of the claim with git merge-tree against the fetched origin refs.

(1) Merging origin/inkling-lamq with origin/inkling-kernels gives CONFLICT (content) in .github/workflows/build.yml. The markers are at merged lines 86-96 (lamq's step header vs kernels' `if: always() && hashFiles('ios/tools/kernels/check_metal_kernels.py') != ''`) and at lines 105-109. The second hunk has `python3 ios/tools/kernels/check_lamq_metal_kernels.py --out ios/build/lamq-metal --compile $ARGS` on one side and `python3 ios/tools/kernels/check_metal_kernels.py --out ios/build/metal-check --compile $ARGS` on the other. Keeping only one side drops one of the two kernel compile checks. The Python unittest steps for test_lamq_ref and test_inkling2_expert_ref sit next to each other in the merged file and did not conflict, so that part of the claim is slightly overstated. The build.yml conflict itself is real.

(2) VENDORED.md auto-merges without a conflict with both inkling-stream and lfm-moe-stream, and the result is inconsistent:
- line 24 is '4. SSD expert streaming ... [agent-console patch C]'
- line 37 says 'The code patches are marked `[agent-console patch A/B/C]`', which leaves out D
- line 39 is a second '4. `[agent-console patch D]`'

Merging with inkling-kernels shows the same kind of problem: lamq's '4. [patch D]' item lands after the K-patch section, under a summary line that only says A/B.

This is a documentation and merge-hygiene issue, so low severity is right. Fix: in build.yml keep both the check_metal_kernels.py and check_lamq_metal_kernels.py steps; in VENDORED.md renumber the duplicate '4.' and update the summary line to A/B/C/D.
